# The Santa Monica Athenaeum

> A membership library for mathematics and philosophy being founded in Santa Monica, California. Primary texts, open shelves, lending. Collecting founding pledges (not payments) until 501(c)(3) status is granted.

## Pages

- [Prospectus](https://santamonicaathenaeum.org/): what the library is, membership tiers (Member $300/yr, Founder $500/yr, Life $5,000), founding thresholds
- [Join](https://santamonicaathenaeum.org/join/): pledge a membership
- [Collection](https://santamonicaathenaeum.org/collection/): the catalog
